en-US.name: Ollama Brain
en-US.summary: Bridge Alexa to a self-hosted Ollama LLM.
en-US.description: Routes spoken questions to an Ollama server on your LAN and speaks the reply back. Requires OLLAMA_URL on the Lambda pointing at a reachable /api/chat endpoint.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask ollama brain what is mars
Alexa, tell ollama brain to explain quantum computing

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Set OLLAMA_URL on the Lambda. Open the skill and ask any question.
